info.description: A production-ready FastAPI template with LangGraph and Langfuse integration

post.description:
Register a new user account (requires admin approval).

Creates an unapproved user account that must be approved by an admin
before the user can log in.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    user_data: User registration data containing email and password.
    database_service: The database service instance.

Returns:
    RegistrationResponse: Success message and registered email.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If email is already registered or validation fails.

Login a user.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    username: User's email
    password: User's password
    grant_type: Must be "password"
    database_service: The database service instance.

Returns:
    TokenResponse: Access token information

Raises:
    HTTPException: If credentials are invalid or account not approved

Create a new chat session for the authenticated user.

Args:
    user: The authenticated user (resolved from user or session token)
    database_service: The database service instance.

Returns:
    SessionResponse: The session ID, name, and access token

patch.description:
Update a session's name.

Args:
    session_id: The ID of the session to update
    name: The new name for the session
    current_session: The current session from auth
    database_service: The database service instance.

Returns:
    SessionResponse: The updated session information

delete.description:

schema.title: Response Get User Sessions Api V1 Auth Sessions Get

post.description:
Process a chat request using LangGraph.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    chat_request: The chat request containing messages.
    background_tasks: The background tasks to run.
    session: The current session from the auth token.
    text_to_speech_service: The text-to-speech service instance.

Returns:
    ChatResponse: The processed chat response.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If there's an error processing the request.

Process a chat request using LangGraph with streaming response.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    chat_request: The chat request containing messages.
    session: The current session from the auth token.
    text_to_speech_service: The text-to-speech service instance.

Returns:
    StreamingResponse: A streaming response of the chat completion.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If there's an error processing the request.

get.description:
Get all messages for a session.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    session: The current session from the auth token.
    text_to_speech_service: The text-to-speech service instance.

Returns:
    ChatResponse: All messages in the session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If there's an error retrieving the messages.

delete.description:
Clear all messages for a session.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    session: The current session from the auth token.

Returns:
    dict: A message indicating the chat history was cleared.

get.description:
Get async inline feedback by ID.

This endpoint is used for polling feedback that is generated asynchronously
after the chat response is returned.

Args:
    request: The FastAPI request object for rate limiting.
    feedback_id: The unique ID of the feedback request.
    session: The current session from the auth token.

Returns:
    dict: The feedback status and content if ready.
        - status: "pending" | "ready" | "failed"
        - feedback: List of feedback strings (empty if not ready)

post.description: Generate summary feedback for a Gemini Live conversation transcript.

get.description:
Return a list of all scenarios available to the user.

If user is authenticated, returns global scenarios + user's local scenarios.
If user is not authenticated, returns only global scenarios.

Args:

    user: The optional authenticated user.
    database_service: The database service instance.

Returns:

Raises:
    HTTPException: If there's an error processing the request.

post.description:
Set the active scenario for the authenticated session.

get.description:
Fetch generated TTS audio for the given audio_id.

Returns:
- 202 + {status: "pending"} while audio is still generating
- 200 + {status: "ready", audio_base64: "..."} when available
- 404 if not found / not owned by session
- 500 + {status: "failed"} if generation failed (still not exposing internal error)
